text: Elean nam Ban, also written Eilean nam Ban Móra, is the Isle of Women in Scottish folklore. The isle lies off the coast, and a green well marks it as the boundary of the world. In the old belief such an island has no fixed time or place of its own and acts as a gate to the Otherworld. The name sometimes means the Isle of the Big Women, who are held to be giants. At other times it was given to a real island, the Isle of Eigg.
